edge_kinds.calls: a method is called on self, a property, or an init parameter — resolved by the receiver's declared type, same rule as android-module-map's codegraph edge validation
edge_kinds.depends_on: collaborator received through an initializer parameter
edge_kinds.extends: subclass of (superclass only, first inherited type on a class)
edge_kinds.instantiates: a type is constructed directly (`Type(...)`), recognized by Swift's own capitalized-type naming convention rather than a call-graph index
edge_kinds.uses_type: the type appears in a stored property

legend.external_nodes.origin: "project" = exactly one other module in this run declares the type; "library" = not found in this run (a framework, an external SPM package, or an ambiguous name declared in several modules)

provenance.ast: read from the module's syntax tree (swift-syntax)

legend.visibility: if absent, the declaration is internal (Swift's default)
legend.weight: number of aggregated occurrences on the edge
